name: CineScreen
description: Free Open Sourced Cinematic Screen Recording

paragraphs: Cinematic screen recording for macOS — turn raw captures into polished product videos.

Native macOS screen recorder built in Swift, SwiftUI, and Metal. Capture any window or display with ScreenCaptureKit; polish it in a per-frame timeline editor with smooth cursor motion, automatic zooms, and gradient backdrops; then export through an AVAssetWriter pipeline that never drops a frame.
Free and open source (MIT) · macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon & Intel.
features: Apple's native capture API drives every frame. Pick a window or a display — CineScreen pipes the raw stream straight into a Metal compositor.

Smooth cursor motion, automatic click highlights, and zoom keyframes you tune in the timeline. Split and remove sections, change their playback speed, and undo edits. Style recordings with cinematic gradient lighting,…

Preview and export share one Metal frame compositor. The export pipeline renders the final video offline at a locked frame rate. Export H.264 MP4 or GIF with aspect presets and crop controls. MP4 keeps audio aligned…

whatItDoes.text: Cinematic screen recording for macOS — turn raw captures into polished product videos.
